title: Binary edit distance has exponential-scale L1 distortion
exact_target: Do absolute $c>0,d_{0}$ exist such that, for every integer $d\geq d_{0}$, some common word length $1\leq n\leq d$ and finite $W\subset {0,1}^{n}$ with at least two words have least $L^{1}$ distortion at least $\exp (c\surd (\log $ d loglog d)) for ordinary unit-cost insertion, deletion and substitution edit distance?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.

families.title: The sharp exponential scale of edit-distance distortion
families.subject: Convex and metric geometry
